No provider key is needed here: it is configured by your BookOrbit administrator. Photo search and Story Guide currently use the server only. Protected features also require device registration in Settings → Device verification for AI. A stock server may reject independently signed apps; HTTPS alone is not enough.
Currently works for selected-text help only. Does not enable photo search or Story Guide. Saving does not send a request or download a model.
